1. **UNPIVOT aliases**: The SQL renames `temp_celsius AS 'TEMPERATURE'`, etc., but DataFrame `unpivot` uses the column names as the variable values.     )

unpivoted_metrics = (
    unpacked_telemetry
    .select(
        "device_id",
        "event_timestamp",
        "firmware_id",
        "has_hardware_fault",
        F.col("parsed_payload.temp").alias("TEMPERATURE"),
        F.col("parsed_payload.voltage").alias("VOLTAGE"),
        F.col("parsed_payload.vibration").alias("VIBRATION"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["device_id", "event_timestamp", "firmware_id", "has_hardware_fault"],
        values=["TEMPERATURE", "VOLTAGE", "VIBRATION"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .withColumn("_rid", F.monotonically_increasing_id())
)

w_cal = Window.partitionBy("_rid").orderBy(F.col("c.effective_from").desc())

calibrated_telemetry = (
    unpivoted_metrics.alias("m")
    .join(
        df_calibration_registry.alias("c"),
        (F.col("c.device_id") == F.col("m.device_id"))
        & (F.col("c.metric_name") == F.col("m.metric_name"))
        & (F.col("c.effective_from") <= F.col("m.event_timestamp")),
        "inner",
    )
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w_cal))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        F.col("m.device_id").alias("device_id"),
        F.col("m.event_timestamp").alias("event_timestamp"),
        F.col("m.firmware_id").alias("firmware_id"),
        F.col("m.has_hardware_fault").alias("has_hardware_fault"),

    .select(
        "trade_id",
        "account_id",
        "trade_timestamp",
        F.regexp_extract("raw_symbol", "^([A-Z]{3,5})[/-]([A-Z]{3,5})$", 1).alias("base_asset"),
        F.regexp_extract("raw_symbol", "^([A-Z]{3,5})[/-]([A-Z]{3,5})$", 2).alias("quote_asset"),
        F.expr("try_cast(execution_details['fill_price'] as double)").alias("fill_price"),
        F.expr("try_cast(execution_details['quantity'] as double)").alias("quantity"),
        F.zip_with("fee_tier_rates", "applicable_multipliers", lambda rate, mult: F.round(rate * mult, 6)).alias("computed_fee_schedule"),
        F.aggregate(
            "fee_tier_rates",
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, rate: acc + (rate * F.expr("try_cast(execution_details['quantity'] as double)")),
            lambda acc: F.round(acc, 4),
        ).alias("total_execution_fee"),
    )
)

gaps_and_islands = (
    parsed_executions
    .filter((F.col("fill_price") > 0.0) & (F.col("quantity") > 0.0))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(
            F.col("trade_timestamp") - F.lag("trade_timestamp", 1).over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES"), 1
        ).otherwise(0).alias("is_new_burst"),
    )
)

sessionized_bursts = gaps_and_islands.select(
    "*",
    F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2).alias("burst_island_id"),
)

statistical_profiles = (
    sessionized_bursts
    .select(
        "account_id",
        "burst_island_id",
        "base_asset",
        "quote_asset",
        "trade_timestamp",
        "fill_price",
        "quantity",
        "total_execution_fee",
        ((F.col("fill_price") * F.col("quantity")) - F.col("total_execution_fee")).alias("net_consideration"),
        F.stddev_samp("fill_price").over(w_account_burst).alias("burst_price_stddev"),
        F.corr("fill_price", "quantity").over(w_account_burst).alias("price_volume_correlation"),
        F.max("fill_price").over(w_sliding_5m).alias("burst_high_watermark"),
    )
)

verified_settlements = (
    statistical_profiles
    .select("account_id", "burst_island_id")
    .intersectAll(df_cleared_settlement_batches.select("account_id", "burst_island_id"))
)

result = (
    statistical_profiles.alias("sp")
    .join(verified_settlements.alias("vs"),
          (F.col("sp.account_id") == F.col("vs.account_id")) & (F.col("sp.burst_island_id") == F.col("vs.burst_island_id")),
          "inner")
    .cube("sp.base_asset", "sp.quote_asset", vol_cluster_expr.alias("volatility_cluster"))
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id(F.col("sp.base_asset"), F.col("sp.quote_asset"), vol_cluster_expr).alias("grouping_tier_bitmask"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("total_trades"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.col("sp.net_consideration")), 2).alias("aggregate_net_turnover"),
        F.avg(F.coalesce(F.col("sp.price_volume_correlation"), F.lit(0.0))).alias("avg_batch_correlation"),
        F.percentile_approx("net_consideration", [0.05, 0.50, 0.95], 1000).alias("pnl_distribution_quantiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("grouping_tier_bitmask") < 7)
    .select("base_asset", "quote_asset", "volatility_cluster", "grouping_tier_bitmask",
            "total_trades", "aggregate_net_turnover", "avg_batch_correlation", "pnl_distribution_quantiles")
    .orderBy(F.col("grouping_tier_bitmask").asc(), F.col("aggregate_net_turnover").desc_nulls_last())
)
